name: checkout
description: Compute a checkout total. Input is a record {i1, i2, i3}, each item a record {qty, price}. Subtotal is the sum of qty*price over the three items. If the subtotal is at least 100, subtract a discount of 10. If the resulting amount is below 50, add shipping of 5. Return the final integer amount.

spec.input: record{i1: record{qty, price}, i2: record{qty, price}, i3: record{qty, price}}
